newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Corp to make announcement after media reports.
newsitem.headline: All Corp to make announcement after media reports.

text.p: All Corp, a non-bank financial firm, said it would make an announcement on Thursday morning after media reports saying it would apply for court protection for special liquidation by the end of March.

"We will make an announcement this morning, but I cannot disclose anything before that," a company official said. He declined to confirm either the reported liquidation or disclose what specifically would be announced.

The firm's shares, which are registered on the over-the-counter market, have been under surveillance since mid-1995, because of its financial state in the aftermath of overlending in the "bubble" economy of the late 1980s.
